issuer: the Ministry of the Interior, at the police administration or police station that issues driving licences
note: Read 2026-10-30. The Ministry of the Interior's page on issuing a licence (a first licence or a newly passed category): the application is made at the police administration or station that issues licences, with proof of paying €20.04 for the licence form in the regular procedure when it is collected (€24.02 delivered to the driver's address, €26.54 accelerated, €59.73 urgent); the €20.04 is held. The Road Traffic Safety Act (Zakon o sigurnosti prometa na cestama, NN 67/2008), art. 216(2): the minimum age to drive category B is 18. Its amendment in NN 64/2015, art. 8, rewrote art. 222(2): a licence for categories AM, A1, A2, A, B, BE, F and G is issued for 10 years. The act has been amended many times since; the other amendments weren't all read, so a later change to either article, if any, isn't held (a reading to check). No identity card is held, and no exchange list was read.
